title: Missing resources on cloud-api
impact: Operations on older resources failed on cloud-api
symptom: [ANOMALY] cloud-api 2026-05-18 19:15-21:05: cloud-api: 116 of 149 log lines were non-INFO between 2026-05-18 19:15 and 2026-05-18 21:05 UTC (peak error ratio 1.0 vs baseline median 0.0). 3 error templates, 0 first seen in this span. Peak p95 latency 1.838 s vs baseline band up to 0.453 s.
error_templates: Unexpected exception while calling image-svc: HTTPError: 404 Not Found

_templates.macro: Terraform change narrowed the image-svc task role to {new}; reads of base images from S3 failed with AccessDenied and cloud-api could not find base files.
_templates.remediation: Restore actions = [{old}] on {resource}; test IAM changes with the IAM policy simulator.

rca.macro: Terraform change narrowed the image-svc task role to s3:ListBucket; reads of base images from S3 failed with AccessDenied and cloud-api could not find base files.
rca.micro: infra/image-svc.tf:118 sets the policy actions s3:GetObject,s3:ListBucket -> s3:ListBucket.
rca.remediation: Restore actions = [s3:GetObject,s3:ListBucket] on aws_iam_policy_document.image_svc; test IAM changes with the IAM policy simulator.

action_items: Require a reviewed `terraform plan` and a CloudWatch alarm for the changed AWS resource.
Alert on the error signature `Unknown base file: /var/lib/nova/instances/_base/<HEX>`.
